title: 第1041章 楚凌渊准备第1040章 识破老三的身份
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 小白说道：“什么事情？”
霍安说道：“之前在开源帝朝那边，他们不是都落子了吗？我的人要被安排去了，我需要你去跑一趟，
他有些事情，没有办法传递了，你要去一趟，将消息带回，同时，将这个人的暗线打通。”
小白说道：“没有问题，这是小事，交给我就好了。”
霍安说道：“嗯，这件事，还需要你和九州商行的人一起配合，我已经和陛下说过了，
安排一条线，负责消息传递，你也知道，现在决议会的人，都在忙其他的，这个时间空档，我们可以好好利用一下。”
小白说道：“这个没有问题，我来解决，那我就先走了，我快去快回。”
霍安点了点头，随后小白也离开了。
萧风也收到了胡海重新掌握环宇帝朝的消息，他叫来贾诩，说道：“胡海又重新掌握了环宇帝朝，
这对我们来说，算是个好消息吗？”
贾诩说道：“不算，原本我想趁着三人小组安排人进入环宇帝朝，我也想安排些人，
但是现在胡海重新掌权后，我有些事情，就不好推进了，对我们来说，不是什么好事，而且胡海是会决议会，
和三人小组谈过话的，具体内容虽然不知道，可是看到胡海重新掌权，肯定他们直接达成了些什么承诺，
这样，环宇帝朝的发展可能要更快了。”
萧风说道：“他和胡海谈，越过了安亮他们吗？”
贾诩说道：“有没有越过，已经不重要了，重要的是他们谈了，而且变了，这才是棘手的事情，
至于三人小组给他承诺了什么，这些，都是他们之间的事情。”
萧风说道：“如果和胡海直接谈，跨过了安亮他们，你说安亮他们会不会有其他的想法？”
贾昂说道：“不会，胡海那个人，做事有分寸，不会出格的，我们需要注意的是柳文，
刚刚霍安传回来的消息，柳文去单独见了贾昂，之后，邢军和芦斌去帮贾昂了，
也就是说，当时圆桌会的人，都出现在了贾昂那边，这还不包括其他他之前的人，
再加上，现在贾昂在冥庭帝朝，处理张珍铭留下的人，这个时间，和程度，都是由他自己说了算的，
这会让贾昂重新燃起他不该有的心思。”
萧风说道：“我们的人，都没有打探到的现象，霍安怎么会知道？”
贾诩说道：“霍安之前埋的钉子，传回来的，不过根据霍安的说法，这个钉子已经是贾昂的人了，
这次来，就是试探的。”
萧风说道：“看来还是有些事情，我们掌握不到。”
贾诩说道：“这很正常，我们不可能全部掌握，要是真的是这样，我们也就能统一这里了。”
萧风说道：“霍安现在是什么想法？”
贾诩说道：“霍安让小白去开源帝朝了，那边有决议会的人，其中有他的钉子，之前不说了，要建立一个情报暗线，
开源帝朝中，不管是赤伶会还是决议会，都有很多人，但具体在干什么，或者说，有什么目的，暂时还不知道，
希望霍安的人，能有些有用的消息。”
萧风说道：“开源帝朝的人，没有察觉吗？楚凌渊不知道？”
content_en:
Xiaobai said: "What happened?"
Huo An said: "Didn't they all fall into the Kaiyuan Empire before? My people are about to be arranged, and I need you to go and make a trip.
There is something about him that cannot be conveyed. You need to go there and bring the news back, and at the same time, get through this person's hidden connections. "
Xiaobai said: "No problem, it's a trivial matter, just leave it to me."
Huo An said: "Well, this matter requires your cooperation with the people from Jiuzhou Trading Company. I have already told His Majesty,
Arrange a line to be responsible for delivering messages. As you know, the people in the resolution meeting are busy with other things now. We can make good use of this time gap. "
Xiaobai said: "There is no problem with this. I will solve it. Then I will leave first. I will go back quickly."
Huo An nodded, and then Xiaobai left.
Xiao Feng also received the news that Hu Hai had regained control of the Huanyu Imperial Dynasty. He called Jia Xu and said, "Hu Hai has regained control of the Huanyu Imperial Dynasty.
Is this good news for us? "
Jia Xu said: "No, originally I wanted to take advantage of the three-person team to arrange for people to enter the Huanyu Imperial Dynasty; I also wanted to arrange some people,
But now that Hu Hai has returned to power, I have some things that are difficult to push forward. It is not a good thing for us, and Hu Hai will make decisions.
Although I don’t know the specific content of the conversation with the three-person team, seeing that Hu Hai has returned to power, I am sure they have directly reached some promise.
In this way, the development of the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty may be faster. "
Xiao Feng said: "Did he go beyond An Liang and the others when talking to Hu Hai?"
Jia Xu said: "It doesn't matter whether they have crossed over or not. What matters is that they talked and changed. This is the tricky thing.
As for what the three-person team promised him, these are all matters between them. "
Xiao Feng said: "If we talk directly with Hu Hai and bypass An Liang and the others, do you think An Liang and the others will have other ideas?"
Jia Ang said: "No, Hu Hai is measured and will not go out of his way. What we need to pay attention to is Liu Wen.
The news just came back from Huo An. Liu Wen went to meet Jia Ang alone. After that, Xing Jun and Lu Bin went to help Jia Ang.
In other words, all the people from the Round Table appeared with Jia Ang at that time, and this did not include other people before him.
In addition, now that Jia Ang is in the Mingting Dynasty and deals with the people left behind by Zhang Zhenming, the time and extent of this matter are all decided by him.
This would rekindle Jaon's thoughts that he shouldn't have. "
Xiao Feng said: "Our people have not discovered this phenomenon, how could Huo An know about it?"
Jia Xu said: "The nail that Huo An buried before was passed back, but according to Huo An, this nail already belongs to Jia Ang.
I came here just for testing. "
Xiao Feng said: "It seems that there are still some things that we cannot control."
Jia Xu said: "This is normal. We can't master them all. If this is really the case, we can unify this place."
Xiao Feng said: "What do Huo An think now?"
Jia Xu said: "Huo An asked Xiaobai to go to the Kaiyuan Dynasty. There are people from the resolution meeting there, including his nails. I didn't say it before, but they want to establish an intelligence secret line.
In the Kaiyuan Dynasty, there are many people in both the Red Ling Association and the Resolution Association, but what they are doing specifically, or what their purpose is, is not yet known.
I hope the people in Huo An can have some useful news. "
Xiao Feng said: "Don't the people from the Kaiyuan Dynasty notice it? Doesn't Chu Lingyuan know?"
